audit.stage: Only after every native selection; union of all actual moves per root gets one common exact completed audit depth.

runtime_scope: Frozen separate source imports; actual production HumanGame route, DisplayOnlyPeer for hints/evaluation; no actual forced expected move, no external teacher or evaluator during selection.
limitations: Public catalog exposed development roots, Budapest prior training/audit exposed.
Same requested time ceilings, not identical measured CPU or completed baseline depth.
Only three seeds per root; root-level baseline drift reported and excluded from creativity attribution.
No complete games, Elo, global strength guarantee, or statistically established no-regression.

clarifications: The selected named motif must itself stay positive after the observed reply.
A new distinct move must itself be an actually selected retained creative move, not an unrelated policy change.
